title: Man. Post. Cap. VII: natural efficiency infects posterity; tip before Cap. VIII
pass_a_gloss: Namely Adam's actual rebellion by its own natural efficiency sowed seed and virus into all Adam's faculties and fixed it to the marrow; that evil crept, spread and propagated by natural generation, and by contagion infected all posterity. So since it is in each human being, it is rightly attributed and imputed to them. Tip: Cap. VII ends; next Cap. VIII opens OT arguments for imputing Adam's actual sin.
pass_b_english: Namely, Adam's actual rebellion itself by natural efficiency sowed its own seed and virus into all Adam's faculties and fixed it deep in the marrow, and that evil crept, and by natural generation spread and propagated itself, and by its contagion infected all posterity. Therefore, since it is in each human being, it is deservedly attributed and imputed to them.
source_text: Nempe, rebellio actualis Adami suum ipsa per se naturali efficientia semen, virus, in omnes Adami facultates insevit, atque medullitus infixit, idque malum serpsit, & per generationem naturalem se diffudit, & propagavit, & contagione sua posteros omnes infecit. Itaque, cum sit in singulis hominibus, merito iis tribuitur & imputatur.
